historical_reviews.related_cases: Aggregate `show memory` row335 cannot replace individual DIMM population and SPD/property checks.

original_test_intent: Verify every installed DIMM occupies the approved socket/controller/channel/slot and reports correct part/serial/capacity/type/speed/rank properties with NVSM health OK.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected CPU/controller/channel/slot population and DIMM identity/property manifest; run exact `nvsm show dimms` read-only; retain raw location/status/health; compare every populated and intentionally empty slot, detect duplicate serials and speed downgrades, and correlate deviations without changing memory configuration.
manual_activity: Platform/memory owner supplies slot-population and DIMM property manifest and dispositions every missing, mismatched or non-OK module.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or alter memory settings
Resolve modules by stable slot/serial, not output order

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but lacks expected slot population and per-module properties.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and join every record to the approved physical slot and serial manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All installed DIMMs, their information and health remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a physical-slot matrix including expected/observed serial, part, capacity, speed/rank and health, plus empty-slot status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes population completeness and placement explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Aggregate capacity can remain correct despite swapped, downclocked or missing individual DIMMs.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Slot naming can differ among NVSM, SMBIOS and board silkscreen; approved mapping is required.

project_override_considerations: Platform recipe owns population rules, accepted mixed revisions/speeds and intentionally empty/disabled slots.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target per-DIMM correctness and health; missing slot manifest is a project input and log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and DIMM manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Adds slot-accurate population, duplicate-serial and downclock checks that aggregate memory totals cannot provide.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory capacity may still sum correctly after modules are swapped between channels, and one slow DIMM can downclock an entire channel. Per-slot identity and negotiated speed are therefore necessary alongside health.
